caseNameFull: Wabash Railroad Company, in Error v. Genevieve Halstead Mathew
summary: In error to the Kansas City Court of Appeals for the State of Missouri.
attorneys: Mr. Frederic D. McKenney and Mr. W. H. Blodgett for plaintiff in error., Mr. Grant I. Rosenzweig for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with ten per cent damages, in addition to interest and costs.
